user.title: Connect to Huawei Cloud
user.description:
Choose how to authenticate:
- Huawei account and password (recommended): nothing extra to run and no cookie hunting; signing in ends other web sessions of the same account.
- Paste a Cookie: fastest; copy the request header from the cloud.huawei.com Find Device page.
- browserless: needs a browser service you run yourself.

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Uncheck a device to stop tracking it; disabled devices keep no entities after saving. The refresh interval defaults to 15 minutes (0 = disabled).

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Huawei Cloud
reauth_confirm.description:
Account ending {account}. Choose how to renew:
- Huawei account and password (recommended): no cookie hunting; signing in ends other web sessions of the same account.
- Paste a new Cookie: fastest; copy the request header from cloud.huawei.com.
- browserless: needs a configured browser service.

account.title: Huawei account
account.description: Sign in with your Huawei ID. The password is used once and is never stored. This installation registers its own device with Huawei on the first sign-in and keeps that identity for later re-authentication. Signing in can end other sessions of the same account, and Huawei may ask for a verification code or refuse the sign-in for a while after repeated attempts.

data.login_id: Huawei ID to sign in as (only when the number has several)

account_choice.title: Choose the Huawei ID
account_choice.description: This phone number is bound to more than one Huawei ID. Pick the one that owns the devices to track.

reauth_account.title: Sign in again with the Huawei account
reauth_account.description: The Huawei Cloud session has expired. Signing in with the account and password renews it without pasting a cookie.

data.login_id: Huawei ID to sign in as (only when the number has several)

error.invalid_auth: Invalid or expired Cookie. Log in to Huawei Cloud again and copy a fresh one.
error.no_devices: No devices found for this account.
error.devices_unavailable: Could not load the device list (the session may have expired). Only the address/refresh settings can be changed right now.
error.browser_login_invalid: Browser URL, Huawei account and password are required.
error.verification_required: Huawei asks this account for a verification code. Use "Paste a Cookie" instead: log in at cloud.huawei.com, open "Find Device", then copy the Cookie request header.
error.rate_limited: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a few minutes before trying again; Huawei can lock the account when it is asked repeatedly.
error.login_session_failed: The Huawei sign-in session was lost before it completed (blank loginID). Try again; if it keeps happening, use "Paste a Cookie" instead.
error.device_identity_error: Huawei could not register this installation as a login device. Try again; if it keeps failing, use "Paste a Cookie" instead.
error.select_devices: Select at least one device to track.

abort.already_configured: This Huawei account is already configured.
abort.session_expired: The Huawei Cloud session has expired. Re-authenticate first, then try again.
abort.cannot_connect: Cannot reach Huawei Cloud right now.
abort.wrong_account: That cookie belongs to a different Huawei ID. Sign in as the account this entry was created with.

progress.browser_login: Logging in through the headless browser (up to about a minute)…

init.title: Options
init.description: Address source, refresh interval, tracked devices and optional automatic re-login. Setup: [README](https://github.com/hotkong/ha-huawei-find-device/blob/main/README.md#auto-relogin).

auto_login.name: Automatic re-login (optional)
auto_login.description: Only used when the pasted cookie expires: log in through a browserless endpoint and store the new cookie. Leave empty to keep manual paste.

data_description.devices: Unchecking stops tracking and cleans up the related entities.
data_description.browser_url: Used only when the cookie expires. browserless v2 endpoint (e.g. http://192.168.1.100:3000) plus the Huawei credentials below; verification codes still need manual action.
data_description.browser_token: Only needed when your browserless instance requires a token.
data_description.username: Used only for the headless-login fallback; leave empty to keep manual cookie paste.
data_description.password: Stored in plain text in HA .storage; evaluate the risk before enabling.

refresh.name: Refresh devices
refresh.description: Refresh every device, or only the selected HA device when device_id is set.

entry_id.name: Account entry
entry_id.description: Limit to this account; with multiple accounts use this or device_id.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Refresh only this device (pick from the device dropdown).

set_cookie.name: Set cookie manually
set_cookie.description: Write the cookie you paste directly, without browser login or device validation.

entry_id.name: Account entry
entry_id.description: Leave empty with a single account; pick one from the dropdown when there are multiple.

refresh_cookie.name: Log in with a browser and refresh cookie
refresh_cookie.description: Log in with the configured browserless endpoint and Huawei account, verify the new cookie, then store it; failures return a specific reason.

entry_id.name: Account entry
entry_id.description: Leave empty with a single account; pick one from the dropdown when there are multiple.

update.name: Update entry
update.description: Turn off to test without storing the cookie.
